real_task: Prepare a repository-grounded AI publisher for a future AI-operated channel without allowing audience analytics to steer the lab's experiments.
observed_problem: The existing public-site test checks that curated reference paths exist, but the repository has no machine-readable contract requiring evidence or preventing publisher feedback from changing research direction.
baseline: Curated site JSON with reference-existence checks only; publisher boundary rules exist outside the repository and cannot be validated by a fresh agent.
hypothesis: A minimal stdlib plan validator can reject every tested evidence/boundary violation while accepting one valid private, human-reviewed, storytelling-only plan.
quality_control: Accept one valid plan; reject missing evidence, unsafe paths, research influence and disabled human review; preserve all existing tests and emit JSON with stable errors.
overhead: Count a new module, CLI command, tests, documentation, example plan and checkpoint maintenance. No YouTube, ElevenLabs, secret, network or rendering integration.
stop_condition: Stop after one version-1 contract. If validation needs external services, JSON Schema dependencies, channel credentials or more than the seven declared fields, reject the prototype.

result.reason: The contract is correct on controlled fixtures, but no real episode has shown whether it prevents an unsupported or audience-driven decision. Stop feature work until that field use.
